_meta.title: UNET
_meta.note: anima-base-v1.0 (Anima 1.0) -- the anime-tuned panel model. The panel is generated as an IMG2IMG redraw of the scene's location master plate (reference-first design): the plate is encoded to a 16-channel latent and the KSampler redraws it with a denoise < 1.0, so the background stays anchored to the plate while the character sd_prompt is composited in. NOW USES LTX VAE + 768x448 resolution for native LTX compatibility. ControlNet, Style LoRA, ColorCorrect, Regional Prompts nodes removed for 8GB VRAM testing.

_meta.title: VAE
_meta.note: LTX Video VAE (bf16) for encode/decode at 768x448. Replaces Qwen-Image VAE for native LTX latent space compatibility.

_meta.title: PLATE_IMG
_meta.note: Scene location master plate (no people) at 768x448. Uploaded by stage3b via comfy.upload_image(); the registered filename is patched here as PATCH_PLATE. Every shot in the scene starts from this same plate.

_meta.title: PLATE_ENCODE
_meta.note: Encodes the plate to the Anima latent space via LTX VAE; becomes the KSampler's starting latent. Resolution is inherited from the plate, so no EMPTY latent is needed.

_meta.title: PROMPT_POS
_meta.note: Assembled sd_prompt (character description + composition/environment tokens) composited onto the plate's backdrop.

_meta.title: PROMPT_NEG
_meta.note: Anima (cfg 4.0) takes a real text negative.

inputs.text: worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, blurry, jpeg artifacts, sepia

_meta.title: SAMPLER
_meta.note: Anima IMG2IMG recipe at LTX resolution: er_sde/simple, 30 steps, cfg 4.0. DENOISE 0.2 (tight plate lock for background consistency). SEED patched per shot.

_meta.title: DECODE
_meta.note: Decodes the redrawn latent back to RGB via LTX VAE.

_meta.title: REFINE_SHARPEN
_meta.note: Stock ComfyUI post-decode detail refinement. Light, GPU-cheap (no second KSampler pass, so no 8GB OOM risk). Knobs SHARPEN_RADIUS / SHARPEN_SIGMA / SHARPEN_ALPHA are patchable from stack.toml [animation]; set alpha 0.0 to bypass.

_meta.title: SAVE
_meta.note: Writes the panel PNG under ComfyUI/output/<SAVE_PREFIX>; ComfyClient copies it into the project panels dir.
